newsitem.title: USA: Cool air to bypass Brazil coffee belt - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cool air to bypass Brazil coffee belt - WSC.

text.p: Cold air building over Argentina on Friday is expected to pass off to the south of Brazil's coffee belt as the warm, high pressure dominating the area continues it's hold over the region, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Thursday.
Fair to partly cloudy skies were observed in the coffee belt this morning. Low temperatures ranged from 54-61 F (12-16 C).

Scattered showers and thunderstorms are expected to develop in the northern region of the belt today and move into the south on Friday and Saturday. Temperatures are expected to remain near to above normal levels today and cool to below normal over the weekend. Low temperatures should be in the middle 50's to low 60's F (middle teens C) on Friday and the low to middle 50's F (low teens C) on Saturday.
The extended outlook calls for fair to partly cloudy skies through Wednesday. Temperatures should remain near normal levels with no damaging cold expected, according to WSC.
